name: Sentinel
tagline: Eliminate Skips, Overlaps, and Guesswork in Every Application
description: Sentinel is a buildable rate control platform for liquid, dry, and NH3 application systems that gives operators real-time visibility into flow, rate, and system performance across the toolbar. It is offered in three tiers - Row Monitoring, Rate Control, and Row Control - and integrates with ISOBUS-compatible displays and John Deere Operations Center with no subscription fee. Sentinel 1000 supports single-product functionality with up to 3 ECU pairing; Sentinel 2000 supports four products for fully customized operations.
specs: Row-to-row variation below 4.6% for 95%+ of operation, average CV of 3.9%
E-Mag flow meter technology with no moving parts, no calibration required
20 mesh strainer with 385% larger passageway than traditional systems
In-cab alerts for flow issues and row blockages; maps as-applied data by row
Three tiers: Row Monitoring, Rate Control, Row Control (individual row shutoff)
Controller options: Sentinel 1000 (single product, up to 3 ECUs) and Sentinel 2000 (four products)
Integrates with ISOBUS displays, John Deere Operations Center, and LiquiShift metering tube management
Displays flow in GPM and GPA; supports liquid, dry, NH3, direct injection, and drill/seeder applications

name: PumpRight
tagline: The highest quality variable speed hydraulic drive diaphragm pump out there
description: PumpRight is a variable speed hydraulic drive diaphragm pump ideally suited for high-capacity liquid fertilizer applications, providing suction from any tank location. It is self-priming, positive displacement, and includes run-dry protection to eliminate pump and seal damage. Current models PR17, PR30, and PR40 replace the legacy D70, D115, and D160 pumps.
specs: Flow range: 2-80 GPM
Self-priming; positive displacement delivers consistent output per revolution
SurePoint E-Mag flow meter with no moving parts
BLUEFLEX diaphragm system with patented retaining plate for durability
Oil-lubricated design allows dry-run capability without damage
Over 15 feet of vertical lift capacity
Models: PR17, PR30, PR40 (replace legacy D70, D115, D160)

name: QuickDraw
tagline: The Smarter, Safer Way to Mix Batches
description: QuickDraw is an automated chemical mixing and loading platform that replaces manual measuring and guesswork with reliable automation, whether a batch needs two products or nine. It reduces fill time, eliminates chemical exposure, and documents date, time, operator, field, machine, and measured product totals per batch. QuickDraw Max is the fully automated system with recipe creation, 4 carriers, up to 9 automated products, and cloud connectivity; QuickDraw Lite is a compact, cost-effective manual/semi-automated option.
specs: QuickDraw Max: recipe creation/saving, 4 carriers, up to 9 automated products + 5 manually added products
QuickDraw Lite: mass flow or oval gear meter measurement, core batching without full automation
Mobile or stationary capability; Venturi or pump suction options
Mass Flow Meter requires no calibration; E-Mag flow meter measures carrier volume
Automated pump start/stop, CANBUS valve technology, iPad app control
Automated hose rinse, air purge, and carrier blending (up to 4 carrier products)
Fertilizer blending: up to 4 high-volume and 9 low-volume products
Available in English, Spanish, Ukrainian, Russian, French Canadian, Portuguese
Add-ons: stainless steel eductor, swing-down eductor, 3" John Blue wet seal pump, ChemBlade, ChemCaddy, BulkBlaster
Integrates fully with Arsenal Spray Trailers for turnkey automation

name: ChemBlade
model: ChemBlade Original / ChemBlade Plus / ChemBlade Original With Eductor / ChemBlade ES
tagline: The highest quality chemical inductor equipment on the market
description: ChemBlade lets operators manage chemicals with efficiency, safety, and speed, keeping sprayers in the field instead of idle during loading. The patented knife-and-rinse head pierces, drains, and thoroughly rinses containers automatically, eliminating hand-handling of hazardous chemicals and manual triple-rinsing. ChemBlade Original is the base system; ChemBlade Plus adds an auxiliary rinse head for jugs emptied without the cutting blade; ChemBlade Original With Eductor adds stainless steel construction, a TeeJet rotary rinse head, and dry-bag handling; ChemBlade ES (Enclosed System) fully encloses the cutting/rinsing process so the operator sets the jug inside, closes the lid, and presses a button.
specs: Patented knife and rinse head opens, empties, and rinses containers automatically
ChemBlade Original: compatible with most 16" inductor tank lids
ChemBlade Plus: adds auxiliary rinse head for jugs emptied without the blade
ChemBlade Original With Eductor: high-grade stainless steel, TeeJet rotary rinse head, accepts 50lb dry bags
ChemBlade ES: accepts 1-2.5 gallon jugs and 10-50lb dry bags; 50-gallon tank, 1/8" stainless steel construction
ChemBlade ES: 1-year full warranty; saves up to one hour per day vs. manual methods
Accessory - ChemCaddy: partial jug dosing, flip-top lid, optional EasyFlow closed transfer, 2.75-gallon tank
Accessory - BulkBlaster: rinses totes in place of the lid, integrates with QuickDraw rinse cycle

name: Arsenal Spray Trailer
tagline: Expertly Designed, All-in-One, Automated Tendering System
description: The Arsenal is a purpose-built spray trailer designed specifically for sprayer operators, available in three lengths (38', 42', or 48'). It features a modular loading deck, all plumbing mounted below-deck for a cleaner surface, an integrated QuickDraw automation system, and ChemBlade with a swing-down stainless-steel eductor, letting crews mix and load batches without repeatedly climbing on and off the trailer. It arrives as a complete turnkey setup rather than a retrofit.
specs: Standard: QuickDraw Automated Spray Tender System, Enduraplas tanks, modular loading deck, below-deck plumbing
Standard: ChemBlade with swing-down stainless-steel eductor, steps & handrail, chemical rinse hose reel
Trailer lengths: 38', 42', 48'; tank sizes: 2,800 gal or 3,200 gal
Loading side: driver or passenger; suspension: spring ride or air ride
Loading method: swing-out load boom (20 ft.) or deck-mounted hose reel (30 ft.)
Axle configuration: dual or triple; additional tote racks available
Accessories: toolbox, gravity-fed 2-gallon hand rinse, light kit, 20-gallon equipment rinse tank with pump, jug storage over fenders, AutoCoupler

name: Tower
tagline: For narrow planters and low volume applications
description: Tower is a purpose-built 12-volt electric pump system for operations that do not require a high-capacity hydraulic pump. It comes factory pre-assembled for simple installation with only basic electrical and plumbing connections needed.
specs: Flow range: under 5 GPM
12-volt electric operation
Electric Pump Driver (EPD) automatically adjusts speed for correct flow
SurePoint E-Mag flow meter with no moving parts
Factory pre-assembled for simple installation

name: Spartan
tagline: For precision injection and micro-volume applications
description: Spartan is a direct injection system for precise application of liquid chemicals, fertilizers, and biologicals without tank mixing, enabling accurate, consistent rates and on-the-go field adjustments. It injects directly into the carrier stream, suited to microbial treatments, variable-rate micronutrients, nutrient stabilizers, and in-furrow insecticides, fungicides, or plant growth regulators.
specs: Application rate: less than 1 gallon per acre
Direct injection into carrier stream, no tank mixing required
On-the-go rate adjustments without stopping
Integrates with Sentinel, John Deere, Ag Leader, Trimble, Case IH, New Holland, and Raven systems

name: Dual Metering Tube
tagline: Simple, reliable, and lowest cost solution
description: Dual Metering Tube eliminates the need to ever change or clean an orifice. Each row has dual check-valve bodies connected to two metering tubes, with an on/off valve to select the small tube, large tube, or both together for the desired flow.
specs: No orifice changes or cleaning required
Dual check valve design per row
Flexible application rates via tube selection (small, large, or both)
Only requires a 20 mesh strainer vs. 80/100 mesh on competing systems

name: LiquiShift
description: LiquiShift uses two metering tubes with automatic pressure-based switching technology to keep the distribution system operating at its optimal performance point, and it is compatible with most rate control platforms.
specs: Dual metering tube system
Automatic tube switching based on system pressure
Compatible with most rate control platforms
20 mesh strainer compatible
Integrates with Sentinel rate control platform

name: Sentinel Row Control
description: Sentinel Row Control uses the Sentinel E-Mag Flow Meter Module to measure flow per row and a Row Control valve to hit the desired application rate at the individual row level; it is the top tier of the Sentinel platform (Row Monitoring, Rate Control, Row Control).
specs: Sentinel E-Mag Flow Meter Module for per-row flow measurement
Row Control valve for individual row rate control
20 mesh strainer compatible
Builds on Sentinel Row Monitoring and Rate Control tiers

name: Sentinel NH3
tagline: The best ISO anhydrous monitoring system on the market
description: Sentinel NH3 is an ISOBUS-compatible anhydrous ammonia monitoring system that uses temperature sensors mounted after the anhydrous manifold to track application row by row, giving in-cab alerts for irregularities so operators can maintain even nitrogen distribution and avoid crop deficiencies. It integrates with existing ISOBUS displays without needing extra cab space and can monitor liquid applications simultaneously.
specs: Row-by-row temperature monitoring via sensors at each manifold outlet
Real-time detection of broken/plugged knives and faulty section valves
Audible alarms alert operators to flow variances within seconds
Prescription application support with auto-average calculation
Customizable set points for over/under application thresholds
Sensor diagnostic interface; row blockage mapping capability
Compatible with most rate control systems; can monitor liquid applications simultaneously

name: Torpedo
tagline: Precision NH3 application with unmatched capacity and distribution accuracy
description: Torpedo is a high-capacity heat exchanger cooler for anhydrous ammonia application systems, built to maintain row-to-row accuracy at higher operating speeds on modern, wider implements so operators can cover more acres without sacrificing precision.
specs: All stainless steel construction
Precision flow control valve with 120-degree control range
1.5" flow meter; adjustable vapor return orifice
Rated capacity: 75 GPM at 100 PSI or 55 GPM at 50 PSI tank pressure
Multiple inlet plumbing kit options (100, 200, 250, 300 systems), flow ratings from 31-70 GPM
Compatible with section valves, A-360 or vertical dam manifolds, and injection manifold mixing chambers

name: Marksman
model: Hydra-Cell Pump / 12VDC Pump / No-Pump Control Unit
tagline: Puts You in Control - Save Time, Reduce Labor, and Know It's Done Right
description: Marksman is a smart fertigation and chemigation system giving complete control over irrigation-based applications, with precise measurement and documentation for row and specialty crops that helps prevent costly application errors through remote monitoring and automated record-keeping. It is offered as a Hydra-Cell industrial pump with variable frequency drive, an economy 12VDC pump, or a no-pump VFD control unit for existing injection pumps.
specs: Third-generation (2025) electromagnetic flow metering
Flow rate control with automatic adjustment for product viscosity variations
Automated shut-down alarms for off-rate or pressure deviations
Batch mode injection with preset gallon amounts; digital record logging every 10 minutes
Cloud-based remote monitoring via dashboard and text alerts
John Deere Operations Center integration (MY2025+)
Models: Hydra-Cell Pump (industrial, VFD, high-pressure), 12VDC Pump (economy, low/medium rate), No-Pump Control Unit (VFD controller for existing pumps)

name: SureBatch
description: SureBatch pumps and accurately meters liquids for injection, spraying, or addition to liquid or dry materials, used for treating dry fertilizer, liquid manure, seed treatment, and micro-nutrient injection into fertilizer batches.
specs: 3 operating modes: Batch By Time, Batch By Rate, Flow Rate Continuous
Stores up to 4 preset recipes
6-function key-fob remote control for external batch starting
Available in 12V DC and 120V AC options
Measurement in gallons or ounces; pump delay capability
Valve operation control on pump start/stop

name: Accelerator
tagline: Get on the fast track with The Accelerator system
description: The Accelerator is SurePoint's complete fertilizer kit for low-volume, in-furrow starter or pop-up applications, combining the SurePoint Commander II controller, an electromagnetic flow meter, a Tower II pump system, dual tube metering distribution, and a tank assembly. It is engineered for specialty crops (vegetables, fruits) and small to medium-sized row crop equipment, with three tank size options.
specs: SurePoint Mag Meter: no moving parts, measures ions for constant calibration
Fertilizer tank: 55, 110, or 155-gallon capacities with integrated flush/rinse water reservoir
SurePoint Commander II: compact automatic rate controller managing up to three section valves
Tower II pump system: dual 12-volt electric diaphragm pumps with desiccant moisture absorption
Garmin GPS speed sensor, pre-calibrated, adhesive-backed installation
Integrated rinse basin for system flushing
Compatible with John Deere and Ag Leader rate controllers

name: ChemCaddy
description: ChemCaddy is an accessory for partial jug dosing needs, with a standard flip-top lid for pouring jugs and an optional EasyFlow closed transfer system that reduces operator chemical exposure. Multiple jug adaptors allow switching between products without exposure.
specs: Standard flip-top lid for pouring jugs
Optional EasyFlow closed transfer system reduces chemical exposure
Multiple jug adaptors for product-to-product switching
Site gauge with individual ounce lines; 2.75-gallon tank capacity
Adjustable o-rings for repeatable measurements
Multiple Venturi manifold options for diverse applications

name: BulkBlaster
description: BulkBlaster is inserted in place of a tote lid; with supplied pressurized rinse water it rinses the inside of the tote until it is perfectly clean and ready to be repurposed. It integrates with the QuickDraw rinse cycle function.
specs: Replaces tote lid for in-place rinsing
Uses pressurized rinse water supply
Integrates with QuickDraw rinse cycle function
